item.title: Choosing Your Token Model - Guide
item.description:
Choosing Your Token Model

Not every community needs the same token model. This guide helps you choose the right model for your audience and goals.

Fan Token

Best for: Celebrities, musicians, sports clubs, artists, public figures

Fan tokens create a direct economic relationship between public figures and their audience. Holders get exclusive access, voting rights, and digital collectibles. The token becomes a symbol of fandom and a gateway to the inner circle.

item.title: Designing Token Utility - Guide
item.description:
Designing Token Utility

Token utility is what your token actually does. Without clear utility, a token is just a number on a screen. This guide helps you design utility that drives engagement and creates lasting value.

The Utility Spectrum

Token utility ranges from simple to sophisticated:

Simple — Token gates access to existing content or experiences. Low complexity, easy to implement, clear value proposition.

Moderate — Token enables voting, governance, or community decision-making. Requires more community buy-in but creates deeper engagement.

item.title: Graduation Checklist - Guide
item.description:
Graduation Checklist

Use this checklist to prepare for graduating from CCASH’s shared platform to your own self-hosted instance.

Community Readiness

  • Your community has been active for at least 3-6 months
  • You have consistent monthly engagement metrics
  • Your token economy model is proven and stable
  • Community members are aware of the upcoming transition

Technical Readiness

  • You have a Linux server meeting CCASH’s requirements
  • Your domain and SSL certificate are ready
  • You have basic DevOps capability or support arranged
  • Your blockchain network access is configured

Data Readiness

  • Your community records are complete and verified
  • Token balances are accurate
  • Audit trail is continuous with no gaps
  • Compliance records are export-ready

Migration Steps

  1. Contact CCASH to initiate the graduation process
  2. Receive your graduation kit (deployment scripts, configuration, migration tools)
  3. Deploy your self-hosted instance (CCASH provides support)
  4. Verify the deployment meets all requirements
  5. Migrate community data, token records, and audit history
  6. Verify data integrity — balances match, audit trail is continuous
  7. Cut over your community to the self-hosted instance
  8. Update your DNS and branding

Post-Graduation

  • Your self-hosted instance is running and verified
  • Your community is active on the new instance
  • You have access to ongoing CCASH platform updates
  • You can route regulated operations through CCASH if needed

Need help? Contact the CCASH team for deployment support.

item.title: Launching Your Token to Your Community - Guide
item.description:
Launching Your Token to Your Community

You’ve chosen your token model and deployed on CCASH. Now it’s time to launch to your community. A successful launch turns interest into participation.

Before Launch

Tell your community what’s coming. Announce the token economy before it launches. Build anticipation. Explain what the token does, why it matters, and how to get it.

Set expectations. Be clear about what the token enables — access, voting, rewards — and what it doesn’t do. Transparency builds trust.

Platform Overview

CCASH is a compliant platform for issuing, investing in, and distributing security tokens. We combine blockchain efficiency with traditional finance compliance to offer the best of both worlds.

What We Offer

  • Issuers: Tokenize assets, raise capital globally, manage cap tables automatically
  • Investors: Access curated offerings, choose your custody model, receive automated distributions
  • Brokers: Expand your product offering, earn competitive commissions, serve global clients

Key Features

  • Compliant by design: Built-in compliance workflows with full verification and audit trail
  • Self-hosted sovereignty: Deploy on your own infrastructure with full data control
  • Legal frameworks: Series LLC and DAO LLC structures for legal isolation
  • Grain architecture: OS-level isolation for every platform component
